title: EX-02 — the informative two-task offline Lab lesson
fixture_label: synthetic Lab fixture — declared instrument verdicts over scripted-lane subjects; teaching evidence, never study or efficacy evidence
negative_controls: stale pin — a drifted card sha256 or edited fixture refuses stale_pin before any execution
wrong count/mean — durable grade recomputation must equal the pinned sequences; a fixture flip fails cells_pinned
constant fixture — a constant teaching-only table fails informative_contrast; the method still reports valid intervals
producer fallback — a withheld recompute input is a typed Withheld refusal, never a producer-side fallback
expected refusals — bad lease / missing row / duplicate settle ride the owners' typed errors verbatim

costs.build: one cargo build/test of hharness + deps (minutes, existing toolchain); no added dependencies
costs.runtime: seconds; one scratch store, 20 scripted-lane subjects across two experiments; no network, no provider, $0

limitations: fixture-only teaching — never satisfies S1/S3, useful-task, live or study readiness
the registered beta{1,1} arm only — the beta{2,2} prior placement is DF-R5.17-1 (owed to R5.40)
exploratory report — no configured sample/budget becomes a confirmation default; no significance claim is made
one experiment per task because a plan's grade map is arm→per-cell-replicate (a two-task experiment would force a constant fixture); the merged folded view is the recorded 20-slot universe
